question:
Select the most appropriate **ANTONYM** of the given word.

Inspiring
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Monotonous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** "Inspiring" **means stimulating or eliciting enthusiasm, motivation, or creativity in someone.(प्रेरणादायक)
 
• It refers to something that has the power to uplift, encourage, or provoke positive emotions.
 
• Its antonym, **"monotonous**," refers to something that is dull, repetitive, lacking in variety or interest, and can be boring or tiresome.(एकजुट)
 
• Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Monotonous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of other given meanings:

 
 
• **Enriching:** This term means to improve or enhance the quality or value of something, often by adding knowledge, experience, or positive attributes.(संपन्न करना)
 
• **Interesting:** This term means engaging, fascinating, or intriguing.(रोचक)
 
• **Alert:** This term means being attentive, aware, or vigilant.(चेतावनी) 
 
 

43:T62b,

The correct answer is 'Option 3&
